widgets_values:
Fumika: an adult manga artist in her twenties with glossy black hair in a messy low ponytail with one light-blue streak in her bangs, light-blue eyes, white oversized shirt with rolled-up sleeves, black ribbon tie, black pleated skirt
Sora: her editor, an adult woman with short silver hair and glasses, navy blazer, white blouse, grey pencil skirt

Fumika grins at the viewer holding up a dip pen in front of a pile of manga pages | #DEADLINE!

Mio sags over a blank manga page at her desk late at night, a cold coffee mug beside her | Nothing...
Her phone lights up on the desk with a message from Sora | !BZZT
Close-up of Fumika, panicking | Seven pages by tomorrow?!

Mio stares out of the window at the city lights, deep in thought | ...
Mio's eyes light up, a light bulb above her head | That's it!
Mio inks a page at full speed, ink drops flying | !SCRATCH SCRATCH

Morning sun through the window, Fumika asleep on her desk on a stack of finished pages | Zzz...
Sora opens the door holding two coffees, surprised | Fumika...?
Sora smiles at the finished pages, Fumika gives a sleepy thumbs up | Made it...

MAKE A WHOLE MANGA

characters:  one line per character      Name: what she looks like and wears
story:       one block per page, an EMPTY LINE between pages.
             Inside a page: one line per panel (1-5)      what happens | what she says

    Fumika grins with a dip pen | #DEADLINE!                  <- page 1 = cover (# = big title)

    Fumika sags over a blank page | Nothing...                <- page 2, panel 1
    Her phone lights up | !BZZT                            <- page 2, panel 2

Press Run. Every page is drawn 3 times, the cleanest is kept.  Pages + PDF:  ComfyUI/output/doujin/<title>/
